children.text: Support Local Effort by pre-ordering delicious pizzas! Every pizza you pledge helps us build our community kitchen and bring fresh, local food to more neighbors.

At Local Effort, we believe great food brings people together. Our PizzaFunder campaign is more than just pizza – it's about building community, supporting local farmers, and creating jobs in our neighborhood.
❤️ Made with love by our team
With your support, we aim to:
• Sell 1,000 pizzas to fund our kitchen expansion
• Create 5 new jobs in the community
• Partner with 3 local farms for fresh ingredients
• Launch our weekly pizza night series

faq.question: When will I receive my pizza?
faq.answer: Pizzas can be picked up at designated events throughout the campaign. Check the Events tab for pickup dates and locations!

faq.question: What pizza flavors are available?
faq.answer: Our menu rotates seasonally! Classic options include Margherita, Pepperoni, and Veggie Supreme. Special flavors will be announced closer to pickup dates.

faq.question: Can I donate without receiving a pizza?
faq.answer: Absolutely! You can make a contribution to support our mission without selecting a pizza reward. Every dollar helps!

faq.question: Are the pizzas frozen or fresh?
faq.answer: All pizzas are made fresh on-site and never frozen. We prepare them the day of pickup for maximum quality and flavor.

faq.question: What if I have dietary restrictions?
faq.answer: We offer gluten-free crusts and vegan cheese options. Please indicate your dietary needs when you pledge, and we'll accommodate you!
